NeoSkriptYamlEffLoad.name: Load YAML
description: Loads a YAML file into memory, under an id other YAML syntax uses. Without as, the id is the file's name without its extension: plugins/MyScript/config.yml is config. With using the file path as the id, it's the path as written.

Paths are from the server's folder and stay inside it; with non-relative they're from the file system's root. A file that doesn't exist is made, with its folders. A file that isn't valid YAML isn't loaded, and is left as it is; an id that was loaded keeps what it had.
examples: load yaml "plugins/MyScript/config.yml"
load yaml "plugins/MyScript/config.yml" as "config"
load yaml "plugins/MyScript/config.yml" using the file path as the id

NeoSkriptYamlEffLoadDirectory.name: Load YAML Directory
description: Loads every .yml and .yaml file in a folder. Each file's id is the folder and file name as written (plugins/MyScript/data/ then the file's name), or with using the filename as the id, the file's name without its extension.
examples: load all yaml from directory "plugins/MyScript/data"
load all yaml from directory "plugins/MyScript/data" using the filename as the id

NeoSkriptYamlEffUnload.name: Unload YAML
description: Unloads YAML files from memory, without saving them, by id, or every file loaded from a folder.
examples: unload yaml "config"
unload yaml directory "plugins/MyScript/data"

NeoSkriptYamlEffSave.name: Save YAML
description: Saves a loaded YAML file. The file is written off the server's threads, to a temporary file that then replaces it, so it's never half written. Scripts see the save at once: loading the file again, or checking that it exists, waits for it.

with an indentation of sets the indent (1 to 10) for this and later saves. without extra lines between nodes leaves out the blank line between root keys. to saves to another file and keeps the id's own file, unless it was deleted.
examples: save yaml "config"
save yaml "config" with an indentation of 2 without extra lines between nodes
save yaml "config" to "plugins/MyScript/backup.yml"

NeoSkriptYamlEffDelete.name: Delete YAML
description: Deletes a loaded YAML file from disk, and unloads it, or with and keep loaded in memory, keeps it loaded until it's saved somewhere else.
examples: delete yaml "config"
delete yaml "config" and keep loaded in memory

NeoSkriptYamlEffDeleteDirectory.name: Delete YAML Directory
description: Deletes the loaded YAML files of a folder from disk, and unloads them. Files in the folder that aren't loaded are left alone.
examples: delete all yaml from directory "plugins/MyScript/data"

NeoSkriptYamlEffChangeId.name: Change YAML ID or Path
description: Gives a loaded file another id, or points it at another file, which later saves write.
examples: change yaml id from "config" to "settings"
change yaml "config" file path to "plugins/MyScript/settings.yml"

NeoSkriptYamlExprYaml.name: YAML
description: A value, a list, the keys of a node, or the full paths of a node's keys, in a loaded file, by its path with dots between keys. It can be set, added to, removed from and deleted; changes are saved by save yaml.
Text set without without string checks is stored as what it reads as: "true" as a boolean, "5" as a number. Text read has its & colour codes turned into colours.
Looping its node keys, nodes or list gives loop-node (the full path), loop-key, loop-val (the value there), loop-list, loop-subnodekeys and loop-id.
examples: set yaml value "spawn.world" of "config" to "world"
add "Steve" to yaml list "admins" of "config"

loop yaml node keys "homes" of "config":
	send "%loop-key%: %loop-val%" to player
delete yaml value "old" of "config"

NeoSkriptYamlExprListValue.name: YAML List Value
description: One item of a list in a loaded file, by its index from 1. It can be set and deleted.
examples: set {_first} to index 1 of yaml list "admins" of "config"
set index 2 of yaml list "admins" of "config" to "Alex"

NeoSkriptYamlExprComments.name: YAML Comments and Header
description: The comment above a root key, or the header at the top of a file, a line each. It can be set and deleted. A comment's lines get # , and the header's ## ; with an extra line puts a blank line under it.
examples: set the comments of yaml node "spawn" of "config" to "Where players start"
set the header of "config" to "My script's settings" and "Changes need a reload"

NeoSkriptYamlExprAllNodes.name: All YAML Nodes
description: Every path in a loaded file, nested ones too, each once.
examples: set {_paths::*} to all yaml nodes of "config"

NeoSkriptYamlExprAllLoaded.name: Loaded YAML
description: The ids of the loaded files, of those loaded from some folders, the YAML files in folders that aren't loaded, or the folders loaded files are in.
examples:
loop the loaded yaml:
	send loop-value
set {_new::*} to the unloaded yaml files from directory "plugins/MyScript/data"

NeoSkriptYamlCondHasList.name: YAML Has List
description: Whether there's a list at a path in a loaded file.
examples: if yaml path "admins" of "config" has list:

NeoSkriptYamlCondHasValue.name: YAML Has Value
description: Whether there's a value at each of the paths in a loaded file.
examples: if yaml path "spawn" of "config" has value:

NeoSkriptYamlCondFileExists.name: YAML File Exists
description: Whether a file exists, counting saves still being written.
examples: if yaml file "plugins/MyScript/config.yml" doesn't exist:

NeoSkriptYamlCondIsEmpty.name: YAML Is Empty
description: Whether a loaded file has no paths.
examples: if yaml "config" is empty:

NeoSkriptYamlCondIsLoaded.name: YAML Is Loaded
description: Whether files are loaded under these ids.
examples:
if yaml "config" is not loaded:
	load yaml "plugins/MyScript/config.yml"

NeoSkriptYamlCondIsModified.name: YAML Is Modified
description: Whether a loaded file has changed since it was loaded or last saved.
examples:
if yaml "config" is modified:
	save yaml "config"

NeoSkriptYamlCondNodeIsType.name: YAML Node Is Type
description: Whether a path in a loaded file is a list, a node (with keys under it) or a value.
examples: if yaml node "homes" of "config" is a node:

NeoSkriptYamlCondPathExists.name: YAML Path Exists
description: Whether each of the paths exists in a loaded file, set to nothing or not.
examples: if yaml path "spawn" and "lobby" of "config" exists:

description: Loads a YAML file under an id, as load yaml ... as ... does, and returns whether it loaded. The third argument says the path is from the file system's root (non-relative).
examples:
if loadYaml("config", "plugins/MyScript/config.yml") is false:
	send "Couldn't load the config" to console
